Dear customer,

As per latest update received from our partner, initial splicing is still ongoing at CD1 location. Further please note the updated impact KAR-MBB FP#3 traffic.


Due to recently identified suspected electrical fault in S1.1b land route and based on current progress of IMEWE S1.1b cable cut repair, there are changes in repair operation steps and related testings. Method of procedure was revised to minimize the impact on customer traffic.

We requested for revised POW from our partner and their response is awaited. However, high level tentative date for completion of entire operation can be considered as 2nd Nov 2026.

Traffic Impact as per sequence of Activity (Exact Date/Time for SA MW will be communicated 4 hrs before the activity based upon the progress of repair communicated by Ship):

1) NON-QOS traffic of MBB-JED FP#1 & MBT-JED FP#2 will continue to remain down during repair operation (exception : NON-QOS traffic of MBB-JED FP#1 will temporarily show up for 18-22 hrs due to NEC switch normalisation during repair).

Note: Before splicing of final joint, NEC switch will be normalised & PFE1WMBB will be ramped down to proceed with further repair activities.


2) Traffic of IMEWE Seg-1.1b FP#3 KAR-MBT is down since 06:42 UTC/19th Oct 2026 and will continue to remain down till the completion of repair.

3) QOS Traffic of IMEWE S1.2 FP#1/FP#2 and FP#3 (except KAR-MBT) will continue to remain UP during repair operation except for below mentioned service affecting MWs:

a) Entire Traffic of S1.1a FP#1(MBB-JED), FP#3 (MBB-KAR) will be impacted for approx. 14 hrs starting from 02:30 UTC/27th Oct 2026 due to below operations:-

i) tentatively from 02:30 UTC to 14:30 UTC/27th Oct 2026, traffic will be down due to final joint splicing activity.

ii) tentatively from 14:30 UTC to 16:30 UTC/27th Oct 2026, traffic of S1.2 & S1.3 will be at high risk due to power configuration activity for switching KAR_BU and MUM_BU in order to make MBB-MBT in trunk to facilitate electrical testings for S1.1b {the downtime has been increased due to recent electrical fault identified in MBT land route

iii) MBB and MBT PFE will be ramped down from moulding till bight release operation and KAR PFE will be feeding till MUM_BU. During this operation, no impact on S1.2 and S1.3 traffic will be observed.

iv) Traffic on MBB-KAR FP#3 is expected to be impacted for approximately 30 minutes twice in the maintenance window from 16:30 UTC/27th Oct 2026 to 16:30 UTC/28th Oct 2026. Traffic will be impacted twice as OTDR will be performed during the post-molding test and again during the post-bight release test.

b) Entire Traffic of S1.1b FP#2 (MBT-JED) QOS will be down for approx. 36 hrs from 02:30 UTC/27th Oct 2026 i.e. from initiation of final splice till bight release and NEC switch activation, tentatively from 02:30 UTC/27th Oct 2026 to 16:30 UTC/28th Oct 2026.

c) To facilitate electrical testing on IMEWE S1.1b, power configuration will be required. Accordingly, MUM_BU and KAR_BU switching activity has been scheduled tentatively from 14:30 UTC to 16:30 UTC/27th Oct 2026. During the activity, traffic of S1.2 and S1.3 FP#3 will be at high risk for approx. 1 hr in the MW 14:30 UTC to 16:30 UTC/27th Oct 2026.

d) NEC switch Activation for restoring MBT-JED QOS traffic will be performed post completion of final bight released. MW will be communicated 2 hrs before the activity.

e) Final power normalization activity of IMEWE S1A along with outage MW will be communicated shortly based upon the progress of repair work.
